themes.admin: Airy Green light theme (scoped under .admin-light): white cards on a pale mint wash, dark ink text. Used by the authenticated admin panel for legibility and speed on the factory floor.
themes.track: Control Room dark theme: frosted glass over the Press Green mesh. Used by the public /track portal as the client-facing brand statement.

body.purpose: Workhorse size for tables, forms, descriptions.

label.purpose: Floating field labels and micro-metadata; the only uppercase in the system.

data.purpose: PO numbers, quantities, dates, countdowns. If it's a number, it's mono, tabular.

shadows.name: admin-card
shadows.purpose: Admin (light theme) white cards: soft ambient lift replacing the glass ladder.

shadows.name: ambient-float
shadows.purpose: Track (dark theme) floating cards, modals, popovers only. Never on in-flow panels.

shadows.name: focus-bloom
shadows.purpose: Track focused inputs and controls; feedback, not decoration.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default control transition; every interaction answers within 200ms.

motion.name: pulse-ring
motion.purpose: Live status dot only; one per section, stops under reduced motion.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton loading sweep; neutral grey on admin light, 7-20% white on track dark.

motion.name: mesh-drift
motion.purpose: Track background blob drift; disabled under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: modal-switch
breakpoints.purpose: Below: bottom sheet. Above: centered dialog.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Press Green fill for the one primary action per view region. Identical in both themes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #10553F; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0C4232; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Admin Status Chip (light)
components.description: Admin light theme: solid pastel chip — color-100 fill, color-200 border, color-700/800 text. The chip IS the job's state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #D1FAE5; color: #065F46; border: 1px solid #6EE7B7; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Admin Card (light)

components.name: Live Status Dot
components.description: Signature pulsing dot marking genuinely live state; one per section maximum. Shared across themes.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #047857; } .ds-live-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; animation: ds-pulse-ring 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-ring { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: 0.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live-dot { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: A calm control room overlooking the factory floor: every job visible, nothing shouting. The system carries the same Press Green identity and status vocabulary across two audience-split themes. The admin panel runs the Airy Green light theme — white cards on a pale mint wash, dark ink text — for maximum legibility and speed on the floor. The public /track portal keeps the original dark Control Room: frosted glass over the drifting Press Green mesh, a client-facing brand statement. In both, depth and hierarchy come from contrast, type, and consistent component vocabulary, never decoration. Premium the way precision machinery is premium: tight tolerances and controls that respond instantly.
keyCharacteristics: Two audience-split themes, one vocabulary: admin is the Airy Green light theme (scoped under .admin-light); the /track portal stays dark glass-mesh.
Admin surfaces are solid white cards with a 1px green-tinted border (#E4EAE6) and a soft ambient lift; track surfaces are 7-12% frosted glass.
Tactile, confident controls: instant hover feedback, focus states, optimistic chip updates.
DM Mono with tabular numerals for every number, timestamp, and code.
Status is always a chip colored strictly by state: solid pastel (color-100 bg / color-200 border / color-700+ text) on admin, translucent tint on track. Color means state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: Admin renders in the Airy Green light theme, scoped under .admin-light; the public /track portal stays on the dark Press Green mesh. They share tokens, status colors, and stage language — only the surface flips. Never leak dark-glass classes into admin without a light override, and never light-theme the track portal.

rules.name: The State-Only Spectrum Rule
rules.body: Sky, amber, purple, orange, red, cyan, and emerald tints exist solely to encode job state (stages, urgency, QC). Never use a spectral tint decoratively; a color a user cannot read as a status is prohibited.

rules.name: The Mono Number Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value renders in DM Mono with tabular numerals, everywhere, with no exceptions. Columns of quantities must align digit-for-digit.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: Admin hierarchy climbs white -> mint tint (#F4F8F5) -> soft shadow. Track hierarchy climbs the translucency ladder (0% -> 7% -> 12% white). If a surface needs to feel higher, lift it within its theme's ladder, don't mix them.

dos: Do keep admin on the light theme and /track on the dark mesh; they share tokens and status colors, presented at each audience's polish.
Do give every admin card its 1px #E4EAE6 border and soft lift, every track panel its 1px 14% white border, and every number DM Mono tabular figures.
Do answer every interaction within 200ms of visual feedback: hover fills, focus states, press states, optimistic chip updates.
Do design loading (skeleton), empty, error, on-hold, and overdue states as first-class layouts; unhappy paths are where trust is won.
Do keep 44px minimum tap targets and prefers-reduced-motion alternatives on all animation.
donts: Don't build "generic admin template" surfaces: no rows of identical stat cards, no default-blue buttons, no off-the-shelf dashboard grammar.
Don't be "consumer-app flashy": no gradients for fun, no confetti, no marketing-style motion inside the work tool.
Don't use spectral color decoratively; if a tint doesn't encode job state, it doesn't ship.
Don't set a dark background or dark text without checking its theme: dark-on-dark (e.g. a #0A1F18 dropdown in the light admin) is the exact bug that hides text after a theme flip.
Don't add thick left-stripe urgency borders (border-l-4); urgency reads through the row's background tint plus its badge.
Don't drop text below AA: admin Muted Sage (#5A6B62) and track Glass Muted (#9FBCB0) are the floor for secondary text and never carry body-length prose.
